formula: 3 paired seeds × 5 worlds × 3 continual-learning mechanisms × 8 updates/world

arms.name: ordinary_continual_sgd
arms.method: one new feedback, one SGD update, no replay

arms.name: limited_experience_replay
arms.method: one new feedback plus up to 4 old samples; FIFO buffer capacity 32

arms.name: selective_neural_update
arms.method: frozen historical ZERO-4 G2 two-group gate controls hidden/output gradients

primary_outcomes: per-skill retention after each subsequent world
development_gate: For each paired seed, ordinary-SGD mean per-skill development balanced-accuracy gain across A-E must be >=0.05; otherwise stop before reading sealed labels.
historical_experiment_records: Read-only; no historical result or checkpoint is overwritten.
